subject: English
stimulus: (a) How can one obtain the skills and attitude of a good citizen? First Paper
guide_solution: Answering questions (a) One can achieve the skills and attitude of a good citizen by acquring practical skills of a citizen. And he may attain these skills by knowing and following some fundamental things of the country. (b) Only knowledge about the fundamental things of the state is not enough to obtain the skills and attitude of a good citizen. One can attain them by practising them practically. (c) If a citizen wants to be a good citizen he has to acquire some good qualities. The three major qualities of them are − knowing the fundamental things of the country, acquring the skills and attitude of a good citizen and being loyal to the laws of the country. (d) A good citizen is respectful to other citizens. He shows respect to others' rights. 188 (e) A good citized is loyal to his state. He always thinks for the betterment of the state. He works for the greater welfare and interest of the country.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 146 — Cox's Bazar Govt. High School

subject: English
guide_solution: Summary The text is about the qualities of a good citizen. One has to acquire some qualities to be a good citizen. Firstly he must know some fundamental things about his state. Then he will follow them. He must be respectful to the rights of other citizens. He will abide by the laws of the country. He always think for the betterment of his country. He must not think about his own interest even he will be ready to die for his country. Thus he can be a good citizen.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : হেনরি ওয়াডর্সওয়াথর্ লংফেলো ১৮০৭ খ্রিস্টাব্দে পোটর্ল্যান্ডের ম্যাইনে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন এবং ইয়কর্সায়ার স্টকে আসেন। তিনি তের বছর বয়সে কাব্য প্রকাশ করতে শুরম্ন করেন। বোডন কলেজে পড়াশুনার পর তিনি দুরদেশে ভ্রমণ করেন এবং তাঁর নিজ কলেজে আধুনিক ভাষার অধ্যাপকের কাজের জন্য নিজেকে প্রস্তুত করেন। তিনি ১৮২৯ খ্রিস্টাব্দে ঐ পদটি গ্রহণ করেন। ১৮৩৬ খ্রিস্টাব্দে হাভাের্ডর্ তিনি ঐরূপ একটি পদে নিযুক্ত হন এবং আরো ভ্রমণ করেন। তিনি ১৮৫৪ খ্রিস্টাব্দে তাঁর অধ্যাপনায় ইস্@ফা দিয়ে সম্পুণর্ভাবে কবিতার মধ্যে আত্মনিয়োগ করেন, যা ইতপুবের্ই অনেকগুলোতে পরিণত হয়েছিল। তাঁর প্রসিদ্ধ রচনাবলি হলো"The Pilgrimage Beyond the Sea (1834-1835), Voices of The Night (1839), Evangeline (1847), The Song of Hiawatha (1855), The Counter ship of Miles Standish (1858), The Tales of Wayside (1863)। এইস, ডবি-উ লংফেলো ছিলেন একজন সতকর্ কবি এবং নানাবিধ বিষয়ের উপর তিনি রচনা করেন। তাঁর গীতিকবিতা বহুসংখ্যক, সুশ্রাব্য এবং আবেগপ্রবণ। তিনি ১৮৮২ খ্রিস্টাব্দে মৃত্যুবরণ করেন।

subject: English
question_text: Corruption is a great problem in our country. It badly
stimulus: hampers all our development programmes. So, it should be removed as soon as possible. 10 Now, write a dialogue between you and your friend named Nila about the corruption in Bangladesh. 298 SSC English
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue between two friends about bad effect of corruption. Myself : How are you, Nila? Nila : I'm fine, thanks. Myself : Nila, do you know what corruption is? Nila : Actually, I don't have any clear idea about it. Myself : I know. Nila : I don't read newspapers and watch TV news. So, I'm ignorant about this. Myself : Corruption is the use of public sources for personal gains. It is a curse for any nation. Nila : I mean, corruption means malpractice, irregularities? Myself : Right, corruption has turned into a social cancer. It is like termite nibbling at the fabric of society. Nila : What about our country? Is corruption practised here? Myself : You'd be surprised to know that Bangladesh is the most corrupted country in the world. Nila : It's really a shame. It means that corruption of all types is practised here. Myself : Right, all types of irregularities and evil practices are done in the country unhindered. Nila : What is the government doing to curb the hydra-headed monster of graft? Myself : The government has already taken few bold steps to prevent corruption. Nila : It's really a bad news for our country. First Paper  Solutions Myself : Obviously, so raise awareness of the bad impacts of corruption.
